citations.title: Our Executive Team - Kristin Peck

sentences.text: Kristin C. Peck has been chief executive officer of Zoetis since January 2020 and has served on its board of directors since October 2019, succeeding founding CEO Juan Ramon Alaix.

Before becoming CEO, she was executive vice president and group president, U.S. Operations, Business Development and Strategy from March 2018 to December 2019, following roles as EVP and president, U.S. Operations and EVP and group president from the company's 2012 formation, and she helped take Zoetis through its 2013 initial public offering.

sentences.quote: Ms. Peck served as Executive Vice President, Worldwide Business Development and Innovation, at Pfizer Inc. and as a member of Pfizer's Executive Leadership Team.
